item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windy over the region. The easterly airstream will moderate slightly on Friday. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, temperatures will fall slightly over the coastal areas of southern China during the weekend and early next week.

Date/Month: 29/10 (Wednesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 24 - 27 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
